source.boundary: Read-only catalog queries against the loopback QA GoTrue database; no user/session rows captured.

scope: Minimal session shape required by current Hub migrations and live-session checks; not a historical baseline or a complete GoTrue auth schema.
columnQuery: select column_name,data_type,udt_name,is_nullable,column_default from information_schema.columns where table_schema='auth' and table_name='sessions' order by ordinal_position
constraintQuery: select conname,pg_get_constraintdef(oid) as definition from pg_constraint where conrelid='auth.sessions'::regclass and contype <> 'n' order by conname

constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

migrationActorReferences.sourceQuery: select pg_get_userbyid(relowner) as owner,has_table_privilege('postgres',oid,'REFERENCES') as postgres_references from pg_class where oid='auth.sessions'::regclass
